title: First return of the eraser
statement: For Boolean words $w$ and $u$, there is an integer time $t$ with $0<t\le 2(|u|+1)$ such that the eraser, started in state $0$ with $u$ on its tape and its head at displacement $0$, is not in state $2$ at any time $j<t$. At time $t$ it is in state $2$ with a blank tape and its head at displacement $0$, with input $w$ and empty output.
replaced:
For any word $u$, there is a time $t$ with $0 < t \le 2(\abs{u}+1)$ such
that the eraser never visits its return state before $t$ and at time $t$
has reached the blank-tape return configuration; the return is positive
even for the empty word.
